com.eloview.sdk

Class EloSecureUtil

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.eloview.sdk.EloSecureUtil

  • public class EloSecureUtil
extends java.lang.Object
    EloSecure Utility is mainly used to call EloView SDK dependent functions like silentPackage installation , silentReboot etc on EloView mode.
    Release Version: "3.34.6"

      • setHeapGrowthLimit

        public static int setHeapGrowthLimit(Context ctx,
                                     int limit)
        This method is used to set heap growth limit (Only for V2 devices). Heap growth limit is the memory reserved for per process/app. Heap growth limit memory should be always less than heap size. Heap growth limit values should be set in MB. Requires reboot to take effect after setting the property.
        Parameters:
        ctx - it must be Activity or Application context.
        limit - Integer value of limit defines the heap growth limit. limit value should be greater than or equal to 192. On fresh boot default value will be set to 192m.
        Returns:
        on success return 0 , on error return -1 , if not supported in device return -2.

      • getHeapGrowthLimit

        public static java.lang.String getHeapGrowthLimit(Context ctx)
        This method is used to get heap growth limit size in MB.
        Parameters:
        ctx - it must be Activity or Application context

      • setHeapSize

        public static int setHeapSize(Context ctx,
                              int size)
        This method is used to set heap size (Only for V2 devices). Heap size is the maximum memory reserved for per process/app. Heap size will take effect only if app is defined with "android:largeHeap="true" in AndroidManifest.xml. Heap size values should be in MB. Requires reboot to take effect after setting the property.
        Parameters:
        ctx - it must be Activity or Application context
        size - Integer value of size defines the size of heap in MB. size value should be between 512 to 1500. On fresh boot default value will be set to 512m.
        Returns:
        on success return 0 , on error return -1 , if not supported in device return -2.

        Parameters:

        Returns:

      • getMaxUSBport

        public static int getMaxUSBport()
        This method is used to get number of max USB port available on devices. Supported only for I-Series 2.0 , PayPoint 2.0 and PUCK devices.
        Returns:
        return max USB port or return 0 if device type is UNKNOWN / Unsupported.

      • setDevicePortsJSON

        public static int setDevicePortsJSON(Context ctx,
                                     java.lang.String json)
        This method is used to enable/disable device ports using JSON string. Currently only USB ports can be turned ON/OFF and supported only for I-Series 2.0 PayPoint 2.0 and PUCK devices.
        Parameters:
        ctx - it must be Activity or Application context
        json - JSON string should be poplulated with required device port status and should be passed as parameter. Sample JSON format can be found in EloView SDK Test App.
        Returns:
        on success return 0 , on error return -1 , if not supported in device return -2.

      • getDevicePortsStatusJSON

        public static int getDevicePortsStatusJSON(Context ctx,
                                           BroadcastReceiver devicePortStatusReceiver)
        This method is use to get device port status in JSON String format. Currently only USB ports status can be read.
        Parameters:
        ctx - it must be Activity or Application context
        devicePortStatusReceiver - it must be BroadcastReceiver and registered broadcast receiver will return device port status
        Returns:
        on success return 0 , on error return -1 , if not supported in device return -2.

      • checkOTAStatus

        public static void checkOTAStatus(Context ctx,
                                  java.lang.String buildPropUrl,
                                  Handler handler)
        This method is used to check whether pointed remote/local OTA is newer or older than current version.
        Parameters:
        ctx - A context object of the calling Class (Activity/Service).
        buildPropUrl - must be a string "http://build.prop_server_url" or "file://build.prop_local_file_path" build.prop is mandatory to check OTA version./
        handler - handler to receive msg's about OTA version whether it is new , old or same.
